page_title: Alchemist Coder: open-source desktop app for Claude Code & Codex

summary.name: Alchemist Coder
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source desktop app (version 1.3.7) that gives a visual interface for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok agents, including live agent/subagent trees, scheduled routines and searchable conversation history.
use_cases: Monitor several Claude Code or Codex agents and their subagents live
Resume or search past Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Grok conversations
Compare changes from several agents on separate git branches
Schedule recurring coding-agent routines with a daily spending cap
Run coding agents with local models such as Ollama or LM Studio
Review and selectively keep or undo agent-made edits
summary.what_it_does: Alchemist Coder is a desktop app that wraps coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build. It reads the history those CLIs keep locally and shows each conversation as a tree of the main agent and its subagents, with live status, tokens, time and cost per agent. Users can approve or deny permissions with diffs, answer agent questions in the chat, and review changes block by block before keeping or undoing them. An Arena mode runs one task across several agents on separate git branches for comparison, and a coordinator can turn assignments into plans for a user-defined agent organization. Routines can be described in plain language, drawn as flow diagrams, and run on a schedule with notifications via a personal Telegram bot.
notable: Live tree of main agent, subagents and their status, cost and changed files
Arena: run one task on several agents in separate git branches and merge the best
Resume and search history across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Grok Build conversations
Open source core under AGPL-3.0 with local model support
caveats: Pro tier (from $12/month) is listed as coming soon; cloud models, sync and signed updates are Pro-only features
Community build is not yet signed or notarized by Apple or Microsoft, so macOS and Windows show security warnings on first launch
Automations only run while the app is open on the computer
Claude subscriptions cannot be used from the app's agent; API keys or the official claude CLI are needed
